answer: In this PoA design, each agent identity is bound to a remotely attested enclave measurement, MRENCLAVE, produced by approved TEE hardware. A verifier accepts votes only when the attestation quote proves that exact code and platform state. Copying keys or launching virtual-machine replicas therefore cannot mint equivalent identities: an attacker must obtain separate physical silicon and pass attestation. The zenith policy seals credentials in a vault, while zephyr rotation limits replay and compromise.
